ast.scope: Lexical source projection; no macro expansion or semantic resolution

cost.scope: The scope-specific cost statement within the invariant-and-cost document; no runtime speed measurement inferred.

obernants.scope: copyfile source directory excludes recursive directory copy. Failed rename with n=0 excludes a returned false status.
A successful destination state admits multiple source roots sharing basename; copy preserves source while rename antecedents depend on provider semantics.
Both source and destination strings are extracted before destination stat; failure message carries operation and normalized destination.
Destination stat errors are treated as non-directory; copy source stat errors proceed to copy and let it diagnose.
Output shape is zero on successful n=0 or boolean plus optional message; transfer destination includes basename only for known directories.
Path handling O(path bytes), transfer cost provider-dependent; no streaming or atomicity guarantee introduced.

coverage.description: Destination directory redirects to child(dst,base_name(src)); fname movefile selects rename, other branch rejects source directory then copies bytes.
